title: ClueCon 2021
html:
ClueCon 2021, the conference organised by the developers of FreeSwitch project, goes hybrid this year: online as well as in-person participation in Chicago. It happens between October 25 and 28. Registration and further details can be found at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

A couple of sessions will be related to Kamailio, a presentation and a workshop by Daniel-Constantin Mierla, a presentation by Fred Posner and another one by Mojtaba Esfandiari.S. You can read more about these sessions at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com/speakers-2021

It is an event worth attending, no matter how you do it, offering a lot of know-how about real time communications and many other open source projects like FreeSwitch, Sipcapture or Janus gateway.

Looking forward to meeting many of you during this edition of ClueCon!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
